meta_description:
1,676 likes, 18 comments - unicef on October 29, 2026: "Women spend 3.2 times more time on unpaid care than men. And, every day, girls aged 5–14 spend 160 million more hours on unpaid care and household chores than boys their age.
 
Care and support keep societies running. Yet this vital work too often falls to families alone, with women and girls shouldering a disproportionate share.

Paid parental leave, quality and affordable childcare, child benefits and inclusive social protection can help ease the burden, reduce gender inequalities and give children a better start in life.

UNICEF advocates for inclusive care and support systems that meet people’s needs at every age, recognise children as both caregivers and recipients of care, and provide decent work and social protection for care workers.

Ahead of 2028, the Year of Care and Support, UNICEF is calling for greater investment in care systems that leave no child, family or caregiver behind.

#DayOfCareAndSupport".
